name: capcut_add_audio_clip
description: Adds background music, sound effects, or voiceover audio to an audio track.

duration_seconds.description: Duration in seconds. Defaults to entire audio file length.

file_path.description: Absolute path to audio file on disk (.mp3, .wav, .m4a, etc.).

source_start_seconds.description: In-point offset within the source audio file.

start_time_seconds.description: Start time on timeline in seconds, or 'auto_append' to append sequentially.

track_index.description: Audio track index (0 = main audio, 1+ = secondary audio).
